hypotheses.title: W1-loop-detector: Loop detector — identical tool calls in a row and repeated text stop the run with a corrective note
hypotheses.plan: Track (tool name, canonical JSON args) per run; on the 5th identical consecutive call inject a system note and, if it repeats, end the run as stalled with reason "loop". Detect repeated 50-char chunks in assistant text (>=10 repeats). Log agent/loop events. Unit tests for both detectors.
hypotheses.expected: unit tests for tool-call and text loops; no benchmark regression

hypotheses.title: W1-evidence-window: Evidence window keeps head and tail, cuts the middle
hypotheses.plan: Replace tail truncation of evidence, gate output and run summaries with a head+tail window (tail gets the larger share, marker in the middle), so summary lines like "412 passed" survive.
hypotheses.expected: unit test that a long pytest output keeps its final summary line

hypotheses.title: W1-output-spill: Oversized tool output spills to a file with a preview and the path
hypotheses.plan: Over 2000 lines or 50 KB, write the full output under the run workspace and return head/tail preview plus the path.
hypotheses.expected: unit test for spill and preview

hypotheses.title: W1-read-cache: Stale-edit guard — refuse edits to files changed since the agent last read them
hypotheses.plan: Record (mtime, size) on read_file/write_file in ToolContext; edit_file refuses if the file changed since, asking to re-read.
hypotheses.expected: unit test for the stale edit refusal
